about.title: An apartment for living, holidays or investment.
about.imageAlt: Aerial view of the ACIKO Residence building surrounded by greenery
about.statement: A quiet street, greenery outside your window and the spa within easy reach — a home for living slower and better.
about.textA: ACIKO Residence is a boutique building with just 16 apartments on Kneza Miloša Street in Vrnjačka Banja. Four apartments per floor mean fewer neighbours, more peace and the feeling that you truly know who lives next door.
about.textB: Every apartment is thought through in detail: practical layouts with one or two bedrooms, underfloor heating and air conditioning, large glazed surfaces and terraces facing the greenery. We build the way we would build for ourselves.

living.title: For living
living.text: A quiet street with everything daily life needs close by — without city crowds and rush.

leisure.title: For leisure
leisure.text: Your address in the spa town all year round: springs, parks and promenades are there whenever you need a break.

investment.title: For investment
investment.text: An apartment in Serbia's most visited spa holds its value, and you can rent it to guests when you are not staying there.

build.title: Quality you feel every day.
build.lead: What you cannot see in the pictures but makes an apartment pleasant to live in: walls of Klima blocks, an insulated façade, underfloor heating and aluminium windows.

heating.title: Underfloor heating and air conditioning
heating.text: Warmth spread evenly through the whole apartment in winter, and air conditioning for summer days.

walls.title: Klima block walls
walls.text: Blocks that keep the warmth in during winter and a pleasant temperature in summer.

facade.title: Insulated façade
facade.text: Thermal insulation and natural materials, for lower heat loss and a façade that blends into the greenery of the spa town.

windows.title: Aluminium windows

faq.title: Questions buyers ask most.
faq.lead: The essentials about the building, the apartments and buying, in one place. If you can't find an answer, call us or send an inquiry.

where.a: On Kneza Miloša Street in Vrnjačka Banja, Serbia, in a quiet area away from the promenade crowds. The spa centre is about {center} minutes on foot, a shop is {shop} minutes away, and the Morava Corridor motorway is a {motorway}-minute drive.

size.q: How big are the apartments and what are the layouts?
size.a: The building has {n} apartments from {min} to {max} m² (net), {perFloor} per floor. Each has a living room with kitchen, one or two bedrooms and a terrace; the largest terraces, up to {terrace} m², are on the set-back top floor.

price.q: How much do the apartments cost?
price.a: We send prices and purchase terms on request, for each apartment individually. Leave your name and phone number in the form or call our sales team and we will send you prices for all available apartments.

garage.q: Does the building have a garage?
garage.a: Yes, the building has a garage. If you need a space, tick the option in the inquiry form and we will send you the details.

build.q: How is the building constructed and how is it heated?
build.a: The walls are made of Klima blocks, the façade is thermally insulated and the windows are aluminium. All apartments have underfloor heating and air conditioning.

rent.q: Can the apartment be rented out to guests?
rent.a: Yes. Vrnjačka Banja is Serbia's most visited spa town, with more than {nights} overnight stays a year. You can use the apartment yourself and rent it to guests when you are not staying there.
